description: Removal of condition 6 (Ground Investigation) 00248/309-317/P9 dated 18/07/2019 for erection of a five storey building to provide twenty five residential units, flexible commercial space (A1-A3), together with roof terrace, external gate, basement car parking, landscaping and associated works.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (New: 4577|03|12(Rev.B), received 01/12/2021 and Application Form, received 09/04/2020. 
Approved (00248/309-317/P9[4a]): Performance Specification and SAP Summary Report (V1RevG), Predicted Energy Assessment and Cover Letter, received: 24/12/2019.
Approved (00248/309-317/P9): Design and Access Statement, Flood Risk Assessment, Planning Statement, Viability Statement, Ground Investigation Phases 1-2 documents, Verified Photomontages, Daylight/Sunlight Assessments, Construction Methods Statement, Delivery and Servicing Plan, Air Quality Assessment, Arboricultural Report, Energy Statement, Noise Assessment, Overheating Risk Analysis, Cover Letter, 1577|1|01, 4577|1|01A, 4577|03|10, 4577|03|11, 4577|03|13, 4577|03|14,  4577|03|15 and 4577|03|17, received 19/02/2019, and supplementary Ground Investigation documents, received 26/02/2019) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 2 - The development scheme hereby permitted shall be constructed in accordance with the materials schedule submitted as part of this application.

Condition : 3 - The development shall be implemented in accordance with the submitted Energy Strategy, and with the full Design Stage calculations and supporting evidence submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority under reference 00248/307-319/P9(4a) and listed as follows: Performance Specification and SAP Summary Report (V1RevG), Predicted Energy Assessment and Cover Letter, received: 24/12/2019.

Prior to first occupation of the building(s) evidence (e.g. photographs, installation contracts and As-Built certificates under the Standard Assessment Procedure should be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to show that the development has been constructed in accordance with the approved Energy Strategy, and any subsequent approved revisions.

Condition : 4 - Unless otherwise approved by the Local Planning Authority pursuant to this condition, the demolition and construction works in respect of this permission shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with Construction Logistics Plan (October 2017), Unnumbered Location Plan, Cover Letter, Construction Method Statement - Received: 17/10/2017. Construction Logistics Plan December 2017 - Received: 05/12/2017 submitted and approved as part of application 00248/309-317/P8(9). The approved Plan shall be adhered to throughout the construction period.

Condition : 5 - Prior to first occupation of the building(s) evidence (schedule of fittings and manufacturers' literature) shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to show that the development has achieved an internal water use of 105L/person/day or less.

Condition : 6 - The development shall be implemented in accordance with the cycle storage plans and specifications submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority under reference 00248/307-319/P9(8-13) and listed as follows: Drawings 4577-04-060 and 4577-04-061, received 28/08/2020 and Cycle Store Unit specifications (Sheffield Stands; Josta 2-tier High Capacity Racks), received 11/08/2020. The approved facilities shall be fully implemented and made available for use before the first occupation of the development and thereafter retained for use at all times without obstruction.

Condition : 7 - No part of the development shall be occupied until a car parking management plan has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The measures as approved shall be implemented before the first occupation of the development hereby permitted and shall be maintained for the duration of the use unless the prior written approval of the local planning authority is obtained to any variation.

Condition : 8 - The development shall be implemented in accordance with the electric vehicle parking provision details submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority under reference 00248/307-319/P9(8-13) and listed as follows: Drawing 4557-03-062, received 28/08/2020, EV Charging Bay Datasheets (Solo Charger S3 | S7 | S22; and Pod Points), received 11/08/2020.The approved facilities shall be made available for use before the first occupation of the development and thereafter retained for use at all times without obstruction.

Condition : 9 - The development shall meet the following sustainable materials standards and shall not be occupied until evidence (e.g. photographs and copies of delivery notes, invoices or installation contracts) has been submitted to the Local Planning Authority to demonstrate that the development meets the following:

o	At least three of the key elements of the building envelope (external walls, windows roof, upper floor slabs, internal walls, floor finishes/coverings) are to achieve a rating of A+ to D in the Building Research Establishment (BRE) The Green Guide of specification.

o	At least 50% of timber and timber products are to be sourced from accredited Forest Stewardship Council (FSC) or Programme for the Endorsement of Forestry Certification (PEFC) scheme.

o	No construction or insulation materials are to be used which will release toxins into the internal and external environment, including those that deplete stratospheric ozone.

Condition : 10 - The development shall be implemented in accordance with the boundary treatment details submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority under reference 00248/307-319/P9(8-13) and listed as follows: Drawing 4557-03-063 and Drawings 4577-BAL-ZZ-GF-DR-A-34-0001, received 11/08/2020. The approved scheme shall be implemented prior to the first occupation of the property in accordance with the approved details and shall be retained in perpetuity.

Condition : 11 - The development shall be implemented in accordance with the delivery and servicing arrangements submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority under reference 00248/307-319/P9(8-13) and listed as follows: Delivery and Servicing & Waste Management and Collection Plan (October 2019), received 11/08/2020. Before the development is occupied, the plan shall be implemented and retained in perpetuity thereafter.

Condition : 12 - Before the development is occupied, details demonstrating that the development will achieve SBD accreditation shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved development shall be implemented in accordance with this.

Condition : 13 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9:00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
